summary: # Animation Production - Animation Optimization p02: Case Two ## Introduction Next, let's look at the second case. In this case, we see a set of tight underwear, tight pants, and a leather jacket. When there is a tight structure inside, it is the same. ## Stretch Marks Application For the waist, we need to apply some stretch marks. After applying stretch marks, we can prevent it from deforming. After selecting the pattern, find the stretch marks in the attribute editor. Click to select. After selecting, you can choose some suitable stretch marks in the preset stretch marks attribute. Here, I use "common." Using stretch marks will make it difficult to stretch. Not easy to stretch means that after some large-scale movements, it is not easy to deform. So, we will use stretch marks in some key parts, such as the bottom of the shirt or the waist of the pants. In this case, changing the fabric of the waist belt to "Fusible Rigid" and stretching for the waist belt application is the same effect. So, in the first episode, we saw that it is also possible to change the fabric of the waist belt to Fusible Rigid. ## Animation Editor Functionality Open the animation editor at the bottom of the screen. By dragging the progress bar, we will see that the movement speed of this action is relatively low. We need to fix some key parts of this set of clothes. Now let's go back to the first frame. In the first frame, we first hide the outer layer of the clothes. Here, we can see that due to the transformation of the morph target just now, it may lead to the problem of our shoulder belt slipping. If we record animation afterwards, it will also slip. So, here we use the function of fixing to the virtual model. We first select the outer layer of the jacket and press Shift-Q. We can hide some of these sheets. At the same time as hiding the sheets, open the simulation, and drag the shoulder belt to the appropriate position. After stopping the simulation, we can switch to the function of fixing to the virtual model. Click on the sheet and click on the virtual model to fix the position of the sheet on the virtual model. After adjusting this side, we will adjust the other side. Make sure that the point between the two points is not too far away when adding the virtual model. ## Adjusting the Virtual Model When adding the virtual model, ensure that the two points are not too far away. After adding the virtual model, we can display all the sheets. Let's go to the model. All the panels can be displayed by pressing Shift-W. Here, because the chest of the virtual model is relatively large, sometimes due to some stretching problems, the panel of the chest is deformed. Here, we select the panel line of the repair panel. Open the flexible settings in the right mouse button editor and set the flexible ratio to 100. After setting it to 100, this edge will no longer deform. When you start the simulation, it will slowly return to what it looks like in the 2D version. This way, we can effectively prevent some parts from deforming due to intense stretching or movement. After we pull it in, we can see that because it is now added to the flexible, the position of the collar looks a bit out of place. We can use the editor's sewing function to move the point on the virtual model, making this curve look more face-sensitive and more round. ## Fixing the Button The next thing we need to fix is the button. Here, we can see that because this pair of pants is a tight pair of pants, its waist is now only maintained by a button and a buttonhole. If the movement is large, the buttonhole is easy to pierce. In order to prevent the subsequent buttonhole from being unstable, we need to re-create the structure of its waist. Here, we first use the move button tool to move the button. To move the button, we use the button to move the button. Move the button to the position near the front of the waist. Because we will create an inner line here later, this inner line will be sewn together later. So, don’t let the inner line and the button have a reunion. Then we use the inner multidirectional line tool to create an inner line, then press Ctrl+C, Ctrl+R to put it next to it. ## Creating the Sewing Line After creating the inner line, we need to create a sewing line on the inner line and the outer line of the board. We need to create a sewing line on the inner line and the outer line of the board. Then take the sewing line and secure it. After it is fixed, we can start the simulation. Let them calculate for a while, and we can start adjusting the button. I will turn off the interruption of the button here. In general, the button interruption is randomly started. If the interruption was started, let’s take a look at it here; it may be a little unstable sometimes. For example, when we move the board, we will see that this button will have some kind of floating feeling in the air. If we turn off the conflict here, it will not have this problem. ## Addressing Pocket Issues Next is about the pocket part. Because here, my pocket production method does not actually merge it into the inner layer to create the actual pocket effect. Sometimes, when we make such a pocket part, we may make it into a fake pocket cloth and stick it inside. If there is compression during the process of movement, it may be compressed from the inside to the outside. Let's record it first to see if there will be such a problem in the middle. Here, we set the simulation quality to 5 as before. Then, the scene change time is also set to 5. In the process of recording, press Alt + 3 to switch to the black and white surface so we can go more directly to see if there is a problem with the board. In the process of recording, we will see that the pocket here will fall out. ## Adjustments to the Pocket So, we now need to make some adjustments to the pocket. But in the process of adjustment, we cannot adjust it in the current frame. Because once we start to make some adjustments to the grid, this action bar will disappear. Because it is a grid, and the information is no longer usable. So, we have to go back to the first frame and make further adjustments. First, we click on the start and go back to the first frame. After going back to the first frame, we can start to adjust the board. Here, I adjust the board. You will see that the animation file in our animation column will disappear because the costume file has now been changed. After that, we may need to start recording again from the beginning. ## Final Adjustments Here, we press I to switch to the collocation outline tool. Then select the edge of this pocket part. Right-click to select the inner shape. Then this edge will be automatically collocated into the inner line. We can switch to the editor board tool, select this line, and use Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V to copy and paste it to our pocket board. Then align its inner line. After choosing the inner line, find this inner dot in the menu. Then move it to the two corners of the board outline line. After moving the end point of the inner line, we can start cutting. Before we delete the extra inner line on the pants, if you don't delete it, there may be a problem with the sewing line later. Because if the outer and inner lines of the board overlap, the sewing line may be mistaken. Then we select this extra pocket board and delete it with the Delete key. After the pocket is sewn together, we can start to cut it out. Don’t forget that because we changed the pocket board first, then the sides also have to be sewn together with free sewing. After sewing, I saw that there may be some penetrations in the process of simulation. So, we first reduce the particle diameter and then simulate. Here, we choose the pants board, reduce the particle diameter to 8, and manipulate the pattern more. In this way, the pattern of the pants occupation is completed. Then press the permanently off key to simulate. Finally, we press Alt + 1 to switch back to the thicker texture surface. Then you can start recording again. ## Conclusion Finally, let’s take a look at the project of the bag. You can see that its space processing is very fast. The picture looks like this. Next, we take out the next piece. You can see that the pattern of the pocket board is like this. You can see that the pattern is completely different. There are actually no more unstable places because now they are integrated into a whole version.
